description: Corrections to bare commit citations in docs/experiments/** and leaderboard/RUBRIC_CHANGELOG.md that scripts/check-cited-commits.mjs flags under rule 2. The citing records, preregistrations included, are not edited. Each entry names one exact token and, for every citation it corrects, the file and an exact context excerpt holding the token once; the context must occur exactly once in that file, so lines added above a citation do not move its correction (#444). The check verifies lost-in-squash carriers against main and fails on any context that occurs nowhere, more than once, or at a citation that is no longer flagged. Resolved by the operator on 2026-10-02 (#368, #390).
